title: Beanconqueror Brew Status Mix
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beanconqueror:brew
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(brew_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the Beanconqueror brew feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `brew_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces the overall mood of your Beanconqueror brew feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
